shared_values: A Formula 1 team depends on clear voice and video between the driver, the pit wall and the factory. Jabra makes the headsets and video bars that let people in offices and contact centers talk clearly wherever they work.
flags: Capacity: soft note. Q3 2026 continuing operations: Enterprise revenue DKK 1,639m (+1% organic), Gaming DKK 628m (+5% organic), adjusted EBITA margin 18.2% (helped by DKK 153m tariff refunds); 2026 guidance 0-3% organic growth, 9-10% adjusted EBITA margin (interim report, 5 Nov 2026).

Portfolio change: GN agreed on 16 Mar 2026 to sell its Hearing business (ReSound, Beltone) to Amplifon; all regulatory approvals met 6 Nov 2026, closing expected by end-2026. GN plans to return at least DKK 4bn to shareholders through 2027; capital markets day planned for February 2027. The user sheet's 'hearing aids' line is out of date; the email covers Jabra only. Check for a possible rename after closing.

Grid note: Neat is Red Bull's exclusive video conferencing hardware partner (to 2027), so Red Bull is closed for video devices. HP, Ferrari's title partner, owns Poly (headsets and video) and its deal includes conferencing technology. Cisco (McLaren) also sells headsets and video devices. Riedel supplies team radio at Ferrari and Racing Bulls.

Customer sectors from jabra.com/business: contact centers, traders, financial advisors, civil servants, enterprises of 500+ employees. Public sector left out (no grid example). Genesys is cited as a contact center sector leader, not as a Jabra customer.
B2C option: SteelSeries (gaming peripherals) could support a sim racing or gaming pitch.
Not an F1 partner (no motorsport in GN newsroom or Wikipedia).

designation: Official Imaging and Input Devices Partner
target_audience: Your target customers are PC makers and consumer technology brands, and leaders from each are in Formula 1: HP (Ferrari), Lenovo (Formula 1), Dell Technologies (McLaren), Google (McLaren) and Microsoft (Mercedes). B2B brands are in the sport to host key clients, show their technology working under pressure and meet buyers worldwide. Teams also introduce partners to each other, to their owners and boards, and run joint activations at forums like CES and Mobile World Congress.
market_overlap: Chicony is based in New Taipei and makes webcams, keyboards and power supplies at plants including Dongguan in China for PC and device brands worldwide. The Formula 1 calendar brings the sport close to Taiwan, with races in Shanghai and Suzuka.
shared_values: A Formula 1 team relies on cameras, sensors and steady power to see and react to what happens on track. Chicony makes the webcams, keyboards and power supplies that PC and device brands build into their products.
flags: Capacity: firm caution. No consumer brand; value case is hospitality with PC-brand customers.
